info.title: InsightFlare API
info.description: Privacy-focused web analytics API. API v1 endpoints use an API key passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. All timestamps in typed API v1 query bodies and response objects are ISO 8601 date-time strings unless the field name explicitly ends with `Ms`. Fields ending with `Ms` represent millisecond values, such as durations or Unix timestamps depending on context. Analytics ranges use [from, to) semantics.
